title: astragalus deterior
intro: Astragalus deterior, commonly known as the "deterior root" or "astragalus root", is a type of plant that belongs to the legume family, specifically in the genus Astragalus. This plant has been used in traditional Chinese medicine for centuries, and it is believed to have various health benefits, including enhancing immune function, reducing inflammation, and improving cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Astragalus deterior include its immunomodulatory effects, anti-inflammatory properties, and antioxidant activities, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as astragaloside IV, flavonoids, and saponins. The bioactive constituents of Astragalus deterior are responsible for its medicinal properties, and they have been shown to have potential anti-cancer and anti-aging effects.
